units.source_text: 我把手探入水中，温乎乎的水藻纠缠在手上。

en.t: I reached my hand into the water, and the lukewarm water weeds tangled around it.

units.source_text: 我首先将蚊帐的吊钧从泡在水里的手里滑落下去，

en.t: First, I let the mosquito net hook slip down from my hand soaking in the water,

units.source_text: 接着将烟灰碟像洗涮似地托水滑落下去，

en.t: then I let the ashtray slide down through the water as though rinsing it,

units.source_text: 然后，以同样的方法将玻璃杯、墨水瓶沉入水底。

en.t: and then, in the same way, I sank the glass and the ink bottle to the bottom.

units.source_text: 该沉水底的东西全部沉尽了。

en.t: Everything that had to sink to the bottom had sunk completely.

units.source_text: 我身边只剩下包裹这些器皿的坐垫和包袱皮。

en.t: Beside me there remained only the cushion and wrapping cloth that had bundled those objects.

units.source_text: 最后就是把这两件东西带到义满像前，

en.t: All that was left was to carry those two things before the statue of Yoshimitsu,
and at last there was nothing to do but wait to light the fire.
